items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you play with Jimmy Woode? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, did I.

ctx.x: Yeah, see what they do is they play with Americans and they get a name and the next week, they got the trio. They had the Hot Club of France, I guess they were notable exceptions. Still would rather the brothers, you know. American, playing with them. They gonna play jazz, you know.
Did you play with Jimmy Woode?
Oh, did I. He was drunk on me sometimes, but I loved him.
